item_name: Rothco Flat Knurled Swivel Handcuff Key
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Flat Knurled Swivel Handcuff Key is designed to meet the needs of law enforcement and public safety professionals. This durable handcuff key is compatible with most standard handcuffs, making it an essential tool for officers in the field. The key features a flat, knurled body that provides an enhanced grip, ensuring it can be easily handled, even in challenging situations. Its swivel design offers smooth operation, while the attached split ring ensures it can be securely fastened to your gear.
